title: Cross-Modal Jailbreak Blindspot: Text Safety Filters Miss Image-Embedded Harm

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Demonstrating that text-centric safety filters fail when harmful intent is encoded in images reveals a clear cross-modal vulnerability with direct implications for VLM deployment safety.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running a VLM, training text-only jailbreak probes on its language stream, and generating image-embedded harmful content. VLMs are large and the cross-modal setup is complex for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: The comparison of text-probe detection across modalities is defined, but measuring the gap as a function of intent-shift to visual channel adds a parametric dimension that expands scope.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
